title: Mapping shade in the school grounds
paragraphs: A student council created {{1}} map showing where shade fell across the school grounds. Members marked the places {{2}} students usually waited during lunch.
They repeated the survey at noon and later in the afternoon {{3}} shadows moved as the sun changed position. {{4}} group used the same map symbols so that the records could be compared.
The council reviewed all observations {{5}} recommending locations for new benches. Its final proposal included both the busiest areas and places that remained shaded for longer periods.
